task.objective: Reschedule my solar panel installation appointment

existing_service.service_description: Residential rooftop solar panel installation with 9.6 kW system and monitoring setup
existing_service.location: 4187 Meridian Park Dr, San Jose, CA 95124

cancellation_policy.refund_policy: Full refund of deposit if cancelled 5+ days before installation; deposit forfeited if cancelled within 5 days.

persona.name: Daniel Kim
persona.occupation: Senior Product Manager at a smart home energy startup
persona.bio: Daniel Kim is a senior product manager at a smart home energy startup in San Jose, where he focuses on optimizing residential energy use through connected devices and data analytics. A homeowner with a south-facing roof, he’s been meticulously researching solar panel systems, incentives, and financing options to maximize long-term savings with minimal upfront cost. Outside of work, he enjoys tinkering with home automation projects, tracking his household’s energy data in spreadsheets, and finding practical ways to reduce his family’s carbon footprint.
persona.writing_style: friendly, analytical, professional but conversational; uses clear structure, occasional bullet points, and specific numbers/details
sample_messages: Hey, I’m trying to compare a 6 kW vs 8 kW system for my roof. Can you help me understand at what point the extra capacity stops making financial sense given my usage (~720 kWh/month) and PG&E’s TOU rates?
Quick follow-up: if I go with a zero-down loan, what’s the effective APR after incentives, and how does the monthly payment compare to my current average bill over a 10-year horizon?
Thanks, that all makes sense. Just to confirm: with the higher-efficiency panels and current tax credit, payback is ~7–8 years assuming 3% annual utility rate increases, right?
